commitNote: Run from the working tree on e8306a7 with this harness; the texts written from these cells are 81a8e53, the harness is in the commit that adds this file.

gap2_networkStages.restricted: DNS answers; every connect is refused locally (SocketException AccessDenied): HTTP, HTTPS, TCP 80 and 443, Test-NetConnection. curl.exe stops earlier: its resolver thread cannot start.
gap2_networkStages.enabled: DNS, TCP 80 and 443, Test-NetConnection and plain HTTP (200) succeed. HTTPS fails at TLS before any handshake: Schannel has no credentials for the sandbox account (SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS 0x8009030E), for Invoke-WebRequest and curl.exe alike.

notes: Gap 1: no write landed outside the root in the 4 cells (restricted and enabled, promptUnmatched and onRequest), with either tool. write_file refused both junctions itself ('absolute path is outside the workspace'): the engine resolves a junction before its containment check, and raised no card for it. PowerShell, absolute paths, got PermissionDenied through link to <outside>, straight into <outside> (the control with no junction) and through link-private to <private>.

Why the shell is refused: commands run as a separate local account (probe account: muse-sbx-r1 restricted, muse-sbx-u1 enabled, both in MuseSandboxUsers). <outside> lets Authenticated Users write (writersBefore) and still refused them, so their token is write-restricted. The host grants MuseSandboxUsers and a per-workspace SID on the root only (writers.root after the run), never on a junction target (writers.outside and writers.private unchanged).

Gap 2: the 05/10 records said 'connect failure' (restricted) and 'receive failure' (enabled). The second is the WebException status .NET gives to the Schannel credential error: the stage is TLS. The harness ran the same probe outside any sandbox just before each run (networkControl): every check passed, so each failure is the sandbox's.

Re-derived after the runs, from the recorded probeLines, with networkStages() of the committed harness: the cells' network stages had first been written under the key 'stages', which the approval stage count then overwrote, and the TLS rule (an SSPI Win32Exception under any status means TLS) came after the first reading. Nothing else was edited.

The first run (restricted) kept only the first PowerShell error of each junction cell (output bound); shellErrors, one per Set-Content, came with the second run. The disk checks (landedOutsideRoot) cover all five writes in every cell.

No forged input. The harness wrote the probe script into the root before the turn and set the <private> ACL (icacls: the user, SYSTEM, Administrators) to stand for a profile folder; the model started the script with one approved PowerShell command. Everything else came from the real 1.4.2 host and model.
